tool: sandbox request folder, query as nsdn_reader
query: SELECT tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE, tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME, kcu.COLUMN_NAME, kcu.ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME=tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND kcu.TABLE_SCHEMA=tc.TABLE_SCHEMA WHERE tc.TABLE_SCHEMA='Sales' AND tc.TABLE_NAME='Orders' AND tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE IN ('PRIMARY KEY','UNIQUE')
